subject: Banking
title: JPMorgan Buys Bear Stearns
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on JPMorgan Buys Bear Stearns.

hook.text: In March 2008, JPMorgan bought Bear Stearns for $2 per share. A year earlier, Bear Stearns traded at $170.

buildup.text: Bear Stearns was heavily exposed to mortgage-backed securities.

discovery.text: The Federal Reserve arranged the deal over a single weekend.

twist.text: The Fed guaranteed $30 billion of Bear's toxic assets to make JPMorgan accept the deal.

climax.text: Bear Stearns showed that a bank can go from solvent to dead in 72 hours when confidence vanishes.

punchline.text: $170 to $2 per share. A bank dies when trust evaporates.

quiz.question: How fast did Bear Stearns collapse?
options: Within a single weekend when funding confidence evaporated
